description: The asset register: equipment the firm operates, not sells (fridge, van, oven). add with cost posts the acquisition entry. Incidents attach via tasks subject_key. Onboarding gear: search_guides.

asset_id.description: For update/retire/get: the key, `<location-ordinal>#<slug>` (e.g. 1#walk-in-fridge). list shows them.

name.description: For add: the asset's name — the id slug is generated from it.

class.description: Asset class: machinery_equipment | vehicles | computer_equipment | furniture_fixtures | leasehold_improvements | buildings.

vendor.description: Manufacturer/vendor, e.g. 'True'. With model, identifies the unit type.

model.description: Model, e.g. 'T-49'. Vendor+model is how service history and recalls key.

in_service.description: ISO date the unit entered service.

owner.description: contact_id when the unit belongs to a client (installed base — an HVAC firm's client furnaces). Such units can never carry cost.

cost.description: Acquisition cost — capitalizes the asset and posts Dr FIXED_ASSETS / Cr per paid_via. Omit for sub-threshold/expensed gear (typical policy: under $2,500).

paid_via.description: cash | payable | opening. opening = onboarded equipment whose cost is already in the opening balance sheet (no new entry posts).

salvage.description: Salvage value (for the future depreciation schedule).

useful_life_months.description: Useful life in months (for the future depreciation schedule).

updates.description: For update: field-to-value map (operational fields + warranty/serial/etc). cost/paid_via/acquired_entry are immutable — disposal is the exit path.

status.description: For list: filter by in_service | down | retired.
